name: VR Viewer for Insta360
summary:
VR Viewer for Insta360 turns your Meta Quest into a personal 360° cinema for footage from your Insta360 camera (X5, X4, X3, ONE X / X2, ONE R / RS 360).

Three ways to watch:
• Camera over USB — plug your camera into the Quest and play your shots, transcoded at the best resolution for your headset.
• Insta360 Cloud — open a public Insta360 share link and stream a whole album in VR; browse a thumbnail gallery and pick any clip.
• Offline cache — everything you've opened is saved for instant, offline replay.
